message.content: {"note_claim": "Fact-checks confirm Sanders' disclosures show net worth far below what satirical America's Last Line of Defense posts claimed, i.e., the claims come from that satire page.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Sanders' disclosure form for calendar year 2024 — the most recent available as of this writing — showed his net worth came nowhere near $116 million.", "reason": "The page confirms America's Last Line of Defense is a satire page and that Sanders' disclosures contradict inflated net worth claims, but it concerns an August 2025 $116 million claim, not the Chinese bank account, the February 2026 post, or the $2-3 million figure."}

parsed.note_claim: Fact-checks confirm Sanders' disclosures show net worth far below what satirical America's Last Line of Defense posts claimed, i.e., the claims come from that satire page.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Sanders' disclosure form for calendar year 2024 — the most recent available as of this writing — showed his net worth came nowhere near $116 million.
parsed.reason: The page confirms America's Last Line of Defense is a satire page and that Sanders' disclosures contradict inflated net worth claims, but it concerns an August 2025 $116 million claim, not the Chinese bank account, the February 2026 post, or the $2-3 million figure.
